progress.message: Reading the model, skeleton and animations in Blender

request: Shiv Rat: Small, twitchy, sneaky. Enemies can't strike back. Darts in and out. He holds a dagger in his right hand and a backpack on his back; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Idle
animations.description: Twitchy rat-like movements: quick head turns, sniffing, flicks the dagger, shifts weight foot to foot. Loops.

animations.name: OH_Walk
animations.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: quick scurry with small fast steps, hunched.
